TPP in international section & ADR press release in national/local news. While TPP is explained better by the American goats, I explain about the ADR.

Background

Indian politics is in flux with an anti-corruption crusade headed by Anna Hazare just three years back & a resulting political movement called Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) under Arvind Kejriwal from there after. The AAP is supposed to be a party of educated, honest, upright civilians that is not engaging in any corruption or unethical pratices otherwise. AAP would supposedly grow into a national alternative political party, once people saw how good it is. At present the national scene has BJP & Congress as the two main national parties with their allies (India has a multi-party system where regional parties get enormous support in their areas). AAP is already a regional force that heads the recently formed Delhi govt.

So what about the ADR press release that should be in the news?
ADR reported a list of political parties that have not submitted their expenditure reports of assembly or national elections since 2011 to relevant authorities. ADR appealed to the election commission to unrecognize or at least suspend the political parties that have defaulted.

Turns out AAP is fully like BJP & Congress in not providing this data. In other words, AAP is hiding its expense accounts in the same way as the allegedly corrupt parties hide their corruption.... and media coverage is almost zero.
